concepts.name: Фотоальбом
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE original high-fidelity website art direction for the Russian brand "повод." selling PERSONAL WEBSITES AS GIFTS, built as a service. Concept 01: "Фотоальбом", intimate modern digital scrapbook.
Output a tall crisp 1440x1800 flat website screenshot, front-on, no browser or outer scene. Two designed sections: full desktop hero in top half and occasion showcase in bottom half. It must look like a feasible premium website, with real clear hierarchy, equal outer edges, comfortable whitespace, not a moodboard or a presentation slide. Mobile-compatible structure implied.
Design system: warm ivory #F6F2E9, moss green #375345, butter paper #ECE3CB, warm dark ink. Cyrillic Onest sans-serif throughout, Caveat-style handwriting ONLY inside a personal letter in the demo. Grid-aligned imagery; gentle tactile photo-paper borders and one small piece of tape INSIDE the demo. No tilted UI, no scattered confetti, no purple, no gradient blobs, no 3D. No arrow icons or circular badge icons, buttons are plain rectangles with slight 5px rounding.
Header brand "повод." left, small nav "Поводы", "Как это работает", "Вопросы", outline button "Обсудить подарок".
Hero layout: 45% left text, 55% right clearly readable example of a personal website as a large digital page, containing candid photos of fictional adult friends by the sea, photo strip, a short personal letter and a tiny voice message waveform with a rectangular "Слушать" control. Clearly put the small word "ДЕМО" inside this sample page. This must unmistakably be a website gift, not a physical photo book store. Place a bold oversized 2-line left headline exactly "Личный сайт\nв подарок." Short line below exactly "Фото, письма и голоса близких в одной истории." Green button "Посмотреть пример", plain text link "Обсудить подарок". One small kicker "Сайты-подарки под ключ".
Second section on a pale moss surface: heading "Для тех, кто вам дорог", four same-height photographic occasion tiles aligned in a clean 4-column row: "День рождения", "Свадьба", "Годовщина", "Юбилей". Adult candid photos, different imagery in each, warm natural light. Small corner text "01 / ФОТОАЛЬБОМ" is allowed in the composition.
Marketing aim: emotional warmth while making the unusual product clear within 3 seconds. All photos are generated fictional adults, no testimonials, no customer counts, no prices, no deadlines, no fake factual claims, no invented badges. Render Cyrillic cleanly and accurately, keep body copy short. Original layout loosely inspired by thoughtful stationery websites; do not copy any existing designer's work.

concepts.name: Праздничный плакат
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE original high-fidelity Russian website concept for "повод.", a service creating personal websites as gifts from photos, letters and recorded voices. Concept 02: "Праздничный плакат": energetic graphic typography, bold red colour blocks, contemporary editorial poster logic.
Output a crisp tall flat 1440x1800 website screenshot with one complete 900px desktop hero and a 900px next section. No browser chrome, no device floating outside the page, no surrounding presentation background.
Palette: warm paper #FFF7EB, tomato #DC382B, lemon #F1D34B, charcoal #24221E. No purple. Onest Cyrillic sans-serif; headline super-bold with tightly controlled line lengths, readable body text. Entire design uses a strong consistent Swiss grid. Plain rectangular buttons, no arrows, no circle icon badges, no confetti explosion, no gradients, no 3D objects, no inflated gift boxes.
Header: wordmark "повод." large black left, nav "Поводы", "Как это работает", "Вопросы", red outline "Обсудить подарок".
Hero uses an unmistakable asymmetrical two-column typographic layout: left 55% with huge 3-line red "Личный\nсайт в\nподарок." and right 45% one large near-square edge-aligned EXAMPLE PERSONAL WEBSITE containing a birthday portrait of a fictional adult man among friends at a sunny garden dinner, large birthday greeting "Это твой день!", two small photos and a rectangular voice greeting widget. Label "ДЕМО" at the top of this embedded gift page. Keep the embedded website readable and clearly digital, not an ecommerce product.
At left under headline exactly "Фото, письма и голоса близких в одной истории." Black solid primary button "Посмотреть пример"; secondary "Обсудить подарок". The hero is mostly cream and red, with one restrained lemon block in the demo.
Below: a full tomato-red section with large cream heading "Для тех, кто вам дорог" and four flat, clean rectangular visual occasion panels on a shared baseline, each with real generated adult photography and labels "День рождения", "Свадьба", "Годовщина", "Юбилей". Do not add an excessive card grid everywhere; this occasion row is the sole set of cards. Put a tiny "02 / ПЛАКАТ" marker at a section edge.
Marketing aim: a memorable celebration brand appealing to friends and birthday gift buyers without reading as a children's party service. All people are fictional adults. No testimonials, customer counts, prices, made-up guarantees or deadline claims. Exact readable Cyrillic, minimal body text. Make this substantially different from a soft beige scrapbook. Original UI, no copied branding.

concepts.name: Личный журнал
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create a NEW original website art direction for Russian "повод." selling done-for-you personal websites as gifts. Concept 03 "Личный журнал", strictly a MAGAZINE FRONT PAGE COMPOSITION, visually different from a left-text/right-preview service template.
A tall 1440x1800 flat screenshot, front-on, no browser outer frame, no photographic mockup desk. Warm white #FCFAF5, ink #272927, subtle rust #A6503E. Only Onest-like clean Cyrillic SANS SERIF, no script or serif except one personal handwritten letter inside a demo if needed. Clear equal margins and a precise editorial grid.
TOP 900PX: Thin header row with wordmark "повод." at left, small nav "Поводы" "Как это работает" "Вопросы", simple rectangular outline CTA "Обсудить подарок". Thin horizontal ink rule below. A large WIDE headline spans almost the entire content width: "Личный сайт в подарок." Set it like a powerful contemporary magazine headline on ONE broad row or two balanced full-width rows, not a narrow side column. A slim row beneath has exact subline "Фото, письма и голоса близких в одной истории." at left and rust rectangular CTA "Посмотреть пример" at right.
Beneath this headline/intro row is a single dominant landscape example of a personal gift WEBSITE, a nearly full-width panoramic editorial photo story: a warm candid fictional adult couple at a train window, right one-third is a white personal letter column and a small readable vertical timeline; the lower edge has a clean rectangular voice-message waveform labelled "Слушать". Put small "ДЕМО" and "Наша история" along the TOP of this embedded gift webpage. The example fills the horizontal band beneath the headline: no text column outside beside it, no floating laptop, no isolated product card on a blank background. The hero demonstrates the website, not a photography business.
BOTTOM 900PX: Completely different from a set of four cards. Large heading "Для тех, кто вам дорог". Left column (35%) is an elegant simple INDEX of four large text rows separated by hairlines, no boxed cards: "01 День рождения", "02 Свадьба", "03 Годовщина", "04 Юбилей". Row "03 Годовщина" uses the rust accent to indicate an active occasion. Right column (65%) is ONE large editorial crop of fictional adult partners on a coastal walk, and a small embedded personal letter zone with a rectangular waveform control. No four-photo card row. This is a selected-occasion preview layout suitable for clicking index rows in development. Small "03 / ЖУРНАЛ" marker at a section edge.
Marketing aim: thoughtful editorial storytelling for anniversaries and personal milestones; premium through proportion, not gold cliches. All adults fictional. Do NOT invent reviews, client statistics, prices, promises or badges. Readable Russian with short copy. No rounded badges, circular icon controls, arrows, purple, gradients, scattered collage, tilted UI, 3D, shadows or dark hero. Render exact content cleanly and make the overall structure unmistakably full-width editorial.

concepts.name: Личное письмо
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE original high-fidelity website concept for Russian brand "повод.", a service making personal websites as gifts. Concept 04 "Личное письмо": intimate warm ink and rose stationery translated into a MODERN DIGITAL service storefront, clear personal website example rather than paper goods.
Tall flat 1440x1800 screenshot, straight-on, no browser frame or desk scene. Two full desktop page sections, the complete hero takes top half.
Palette pale blush #F2DCD5, deep wine #692D38, soft ivory #FFF9F0, muted rose #C58C88. Keep light and warm with sufficient text contrast. Use Onest Cyrillic sans-serif throughout the actual storefront, Caveat handwritten script ONLY within a short personal letter in the demo gift.
Header uses bold "повод." wordmark, nav "Поводы", "Как это работает", "Вопросы", understated rectangular CTA "Обсудить подарок". No ornament logo.
Hero split balanced 50/50: left huge dark-wine clean sans-serif headline exactly "Личный сайт\nв подарок.", line "Фото, письма и голоса близких в одной истории.", wine button "Посмотреть пример", second text action "Обсудить подарок". Right: a large FLAT product preview of an actual personal gift web page arranged as an opened online letter. It should contain a rectangular candid photo of fictional adult couple laughing over coffee, one warm handwritten sentence "Как хорошо, что мы встретились.", a small voice recording waveform with a rectangular "Слушать" button, and a photo strip. Top "ДЕМО" and "Письмо для тебя". A small front-facing smartphone inset overlaps only the product preview corner, showing the SAME personal web page on mobile, maintaining clear alignment and hierarchy. Realistic flat digital UI, no physical envelope substitute, no flowers covering copy.
The lower section is ivory with wine text "Для тех, кто вам дорог". Four generous edge-aligned rectangular occasion photographs, short labels "День рождения", "Свадьба", "Годовщина", "Юбилей"; include friends and a family so the service is not exclusively romantic. A fine rose rule and tiny "04 / ПИСЬМО" marker complete the layout.
No circular decorative badges, no arrows, no serif storefront headings, no heart pattern, no gradients, no purple, no tilted UI, no floating 3D box. No made-up reviews, customers or prices, no fake deadline guarantee. Fictional adult people only. Clean accurate Cyrillic. Marketing aim: giving voice to personal words and meaningful memories, suitable for relationships and family, with a clear example of the digital product. Original layout, do not imitate a specific designer's composition.

concepts.name: Витрина примеров
concepts.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Create ONE original high-fidelity website art direction for Russian "повод.", a done-for-you service that makes personal websites as gifts. Concept 05 "Витрина примеров": crisp product demonstration, immediate clarity, flexible occasion selection, contemporary friendly minimal design.
Tall flat 1440x1800 straight-on website screenshot, no browser outer chrome, no extra presentation background. Top 900px one coherent full hero, bottom 900px one full showcase section. Excellent grid, equal left/right edges, readable digital product UI.
Palette paper white #FAFBF8, pale sky #E7F0F1, deep petrol #174853, apricot accent #ECA77E. NO purple, electric tech glow, gradient blobs, 3D or dark hero. Cyrillic Onest sans-serif everywhere, oversized 80px-ish headline, normal readable paragraph, 6px radius plain rectangular buttons. No arrows or circular icon badges.
Header: bold wordmark "повод.", nav "Поводы", "Как это работает", "Вопросы", petrol button "Обсудить подарок".
Hero is distinctive and CENTRED rather than a left/right scrapbook: small kicker "Сайты-подарки под ключ"; centred huge headline exactly "Личный сайт в подарок."; concise subline "Фото, письма и голоса близких в одной истории."; primary petrol button "Посмотреть пример" and secondary text "Обсудить подарок". Below, a broad front-facing DIGITAL GIFT WEBSITE PREVIEW fills the remaining hero: no 3D device, simple thin browser-like top strip without traffic-light circles; four rectangular selectors along its top edge "День рождения", "Свадьба", "Годовщина", "Юбилей", with День рождения visibly active. The visible personal gift page contains a wide sunny candid adult friends photograph on the left and a personal birthday note plus voice-message waveform on the right. It says "ДЕМО" and "Это твой день!" so it's clearly an example of the delivered personal WEBSITE.
Below a pale sky-blue full section "Для тех, кто вам дорог" with four large clearly distinct visual previews of gift websites for "День рождения", "Свадьба", "Годовщина", "Юбилей", in a two by two grid, each preview includes a photograph and simple page typography rather than shopping product pictures. A tiny "05 / ПРИМЕРЫ" marker is okay.
Marketing aim: people understand the product and can choose a relevant example without reading a wall of copy. This should feel like a thoughtfully crafted consumer service, never like a generic SaaS dashboard, florist, greeting card store or gift-box ecommerce. Use diverse fictional adults, no reviews, no customer counts, no prices or unverified turnaround promises. Exact readable Russian, restrained typography, no excessive decorative clutter, original design.
concepts.refinement_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
This is the target website concept image. Preserve the entire image exactly: same typography, Russian copy, photos, colours, sizes, composition and all other UI. Make ONE tiny UI correction only in the LARGE MAIN demo preview: replace the circular play icon at the left of its audio waveform with a small plain rectangular deep-petrol button with readable white text "Слушать". Preserve the waveform and time display. There must be no round play button. Do not change anything else, do not add design variants or crop the page.
